howto.name: Upload a video file
howto.text: Drop an MP4/MOV/MKV/WebM file up to 200 MB.

howto.name: Choose output format
howto.text: MP3 (universal), WAV (uncompressed), OGG (open), FLAC (lossless), AAC (high quality).

howto.name: Download the audio track
howto.text: FFmpeg extracts the audio stream and re-encodes it to the chosen format, even when the video already carries that format.

faq.a: WAV and FLAC store the decoded audio without further loss. MP3, AAC and OGG are re-encoded at the encoders' default settings, about 128 kbps for stereo MP3 and AAC, and there is no bitrate setting here.

faq.q: What if the video has multiple audio tracks?
faq.a: The first (default) audio track is extracted. Choosing another track, or extracting several at once, is not supported.

faq.q: Can I extract just a section of the audio?
faq.a: Use Trim Media first to isolate the section, then extract audio from the trimmed video.

faq.q: Does the audio file keep where the video was recorded?
faq.a: No. The location (GPS), the make, model and software of the phone or camera, the recording date, and tags such as the title, artist and comments are left out. An MP3 keeps the video's chapter markers and their titles, and an OGG keeps the sound track's language; the other formats come out with neither.
